question: On which date, the members of the Constituent assembly appended their signature to the Constitution as finally passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24 January 1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Making of the Indian Constitution

 
 
• ​The first meeting of the Constituent Assembly, 9th** December 1946.**
 
• The first meeting of the Constituent Assembly was attended by 205 members, including 9 women under the chairmanship of Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar receiving representation during the proceeding of the Constituent Assembly -- **December 1946-November 1949.**
 
• Its last session was held on **24 January 1950.**
